claims.quote: Pathogenic variants in STXBP1 are a well-established cause of developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE)
STXBP1 variants may underlie epilepsies of variable severity, extending from milder epilepsy syndromes to DEE
Gly236Val segregated in a family with epilepsy with febrile seizures plus
Pro434Leu was inherited in a family with self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes with incomplete penetrance
including one truncating variant (Lys63Ter) and seven missense variants
their effects on Munc18-1 expression were evaluated by immunoblotting in transfected HEK293T cells
immunoblotting showed markedly reduced Munc18-1 levels for DEE-associated missense variants

claims.object_text: Munc18-1 levels similar to wild-type expression
claims.quote: Gly236Val and Pro434Leu preserved similar Munc18-1 levels to wild-type expression

claims.object_text: milder destabilizing effects and greater solvent accessibility compared to DEE-associated variants
claims.quote: In silico analyses suggested that Gly236Val and Pro434Leu had comparatively milder destabilizing effects and were located at more solvent-accessible positions than DEE-associated variants
Five de novo missense variants (Pro187Leu, Arg190Gln, Ala251Thr, Arg292His, and Gly544Val) and one de novo truncating variant were observed exclusively in individuals with DEE

claims.object_text: clinical severity tracks with predicted structural/biophysical impact and Munc18-1 abundance
claims.quote: Clinical severity broadly tracks with the predicted structural/biophysical impact of the variant and Munc18-1 abundance
